Chickenpox PCR.notes: Same organism/code as Varicella PCR (VZV). Generic specimen, probe-detection method assumed; not confirmed against actual lab platform.

Varicella PCR.notes: Same organism/code as Chickenpox PCR -- these are the same real-world test under two vocabulary entries (see decisions-log.md, 2026-07-29).

Dengue IgM Serology.notes: Qualitative Presence in Serum, matches result field shape.

Dengue NS1 Antigen Test.notes: Presence in Serum/Plasma/Blood by Rapid immunoassay.

Influenza PCR.notes: Generic-specimen code. A respiratory-specimen-specific variant exists; revisit once specimen_type data for this test is reviewed.

Influenza Rapid Antigen Test.notes: A+B combined, Presence in Nose by Rapid immunoassay.

Meningococcal CSF Culture.notes: Neisseria meningitidis Presence in CSF by Organism specific culture.

Meningococcal Gram Stain.notes: Fully generic 'Microscopic observation in Specimen by Gram stain' -- not CSF-specific and not Meningococcus-specific (Gram stain identifies morphology, not species, so a more specific code may not exist even in principle).

Salmonella Stool Culture.notes: Salmonella sp Presence in Stool by Culture.

Typhoid Blood Culture.notes: Closest available is fully generic 'Bacteria identified in Blood by Culture' -- not Salmonella typhi-specific. No species-specific blood-culture LOINC code was found.

Typhoid Widal Test.notes: Captures the O-antigen titer only (Salmonella typhi O Ab [Presence] in Serum). Widal is really two separate titers (O antigen + H antigen, 13284-5) -- current one-code-per-test schema can't represent both. Also flagged by Dr. Sameh as a legacy/optional test clinically, not primary (see decisions-log.md).

Anthrax Blood Culture.notes: Bacillus anthracis Presence in Specimen by Organism specific culture -- generic specimen, not Blood-specific, but organism-specific.

Botulism Toxin Assay.notes: Clostridium botulinum toxin Presence in Specimen by Mouse bioassay. Approved by Dr. Sameh.

Brucellosis Blood Culture.notes: Brucella sp identified in Blood by Organism specific culture.

Brucellosis Serology.notes: Brucella sp Ab [Titer] in Serum by Agglutination.

Campylobacter Stool Culture.notes: Campylobacter sp identified in Stool by Organism specific culture.

Chlamydia NAAT.notes: Generic-specimen NAA code; genital/urine-specific variants exist if needed later.

HIV Antigen/Antibody Combo Immunoassay.notes: HIV 1+2 Ab+HIV1 p24 Ag Presence in Serum or Plasma by Immunoassay.

HIV RNA PCR.notes: Viral load, generic specimen; Serum/Plasma-specific variant (20447-9) available if needed.

Syphilis RPR Test.notes: Reagin Ab Presence in Serum by RPR -- standard screening test.

Chancroid PCR.notes: Haemophilus ducreyi DNA Presence by NAA. Approved.

Chikungunya PCR.notes: Serum/Plasma molecular test; actual specimen kept as metadata. Approved.

Cholera Stool Culture.notes: Vibrio sp identified in Stool by Organism specific culture -- genus-level, not V. cholerae-specific. Dr. Sameh: approve, but the specific organism result (V. cholerae) must be stored separately from the LOINC observation.

Cyclospora Stool PCR.notes: Cyclospora cayetanensis DNA Presence in Stool by NAA with non-probe detection. Dr. Sameh: non-probe method is not a reason to reject -- LOINC itself documents this as the qualitative molecular detection code (created for platforms like FilmArray GI Panel). Approved as-is, not as a compromise.

Diphtheria Throat Culture.notes: Corynebacterium diphtheriae Presence in Throat by Culture. Approved.

Ebola PCR.notes: Generic specimen accepted per Dr. Sameh.

Haemophilus influenzae Culture.notes: Organism-specific, correct; specimen generic (not Blood/CSF-specific). Dr. Sameh: approve, store actual specimen (Blood/CSF/etc.) separately.

Hantavirus IgM Serology.notes: REJECTED as default by Dr. Sameh: 101216-0 is Hantavirus SIN NOMBRE-specific (Line blot method), not a generic Hantavirus IgM code -- using it as the default would silently narrow every case to one specific viral subtype without evidence. Left unmapped (test_code stays null) until the actual assay used by the lab is confirmed; may need a local/institutional code in the meantime, not a forced LOINC match.

Hepatitis B DNA PCR.notes: Qualitative HBV DNA. Approved -- do not reuse for viral-load/quantitative reporting.

Hepatitis C RNA PCR.notes: Qualitative HCV RNA. Approved -- do not reuse for viral-load/quantitative reporting.

Leprosy Skin Biopsy.notes: No analyte LOINC exists -- this is histopathology, not a discrete lab analyte. Dr. Sameh: treat as a pathology/biopsy report workflow, not an organism-test LOINC. Left unmapped by design, not an oversight.

Listeria Culture.notes: Listeria sp identified in Specimen by Organism specific culture -- genus-level, not L. monocytogenes-specific. Dr. Sameh: approve, store the specific organism result separately.

Lyme Disease Two-Tier Serology.notes: Tier-1 screening EIA (Borrelia burgdorferi IgG+IgM Ab Presence in Serum). Dr. Sameh: this is genuinely a TWO-CODE test -- Tier 2 (confirmatory) is 18203-0 (immunoblot) or a second EIA per a modified algorithm. Current schema only stores one test_code; Tier 2 result is not yet representable. This is the strongest case in the whole file for a schema change (a second result field), matching the same gap already flagged for the Widal test.

Malaria Rapid Diagnostic Test.notes: Genus-level Plasmodium sp Ag [Identifier] -- Dr. Sameh: acceptable as the general concept; species-specific result (e.g. P. falciparum, 76772-3) stored separately when available.

Meningococcal Blood Culture.notes: Organism correct (Neisseria meningitidis); specimen generic, not Blood-specific. Approved, store Blood as specimen metadata.

Plague Culture.notes: Organism and method correct (Yersinia pestis, culture); specimen generic. Approved.

Poliovirus Stool PCR.notes: REJECTED by Dr. Sameh: 53645-8 is a CULTURE code ('Polio virus identified in Stool by Organism specific culture'), not a PCR/molecular code -- using it for a test named 'PCR' would be a genuine method mismatch, not just a granularity compromise. No poliovirus-specific RNA/NAA LOINC code exists; molecular detection is typically reported under a broader Enterovirus RNA code (29591-5) at other labs, but that changes the analyte, not just the method, so it is NOT substituted here either. Left unmapped (test_code null) pending a local test concept or confirmation of what the actual lab assay reports.

Psittacosis PCR.notes: Chlamydia sp DNA Presence -- genus-level fallback, NOT C. psittaci-specific (no organism-specific NAA code exists for C. psittaci). Dr. Sameh: approve only as a fallback, with the understanding that the specific organism/disease context must be carried as separate metadata, not implied by the LOINC code alone.

Q Fever Serology.notes: Coxiella burnetii Phase II IgG Ab Presence in Serum. Dr. Sameh: appropriate for ACUTE infection screening (matches CDC guidance that Phase II IgG dominates acute response), but should be treated as ONE COMPONENT of Q fever serology, not the definition of the whole test -- Phase I IgG/IgM (relevant for chronic/persistent infection) and Phase II IgM are separate LOINC observations not currently captured. Revisit if the platform starts tracking chronic Q fever.

Rabies Direct Fluorescent Antibody Test.notes: Rabies virus Ag Presence in Tissue by Immunofluorescence. Approved.

Rabies Saliva RT-PCR.notes: Molecular concept correct; specimen generic, not Saliva-specific. Approved, store Saliva as specimen metadata.

Smallpox PCR.notes: Orthopoxvirus DNA [Identifier] -- deliberate surveillance proxy, since NO Variola-specific LOINC code exists at all. Dr. Sameh: approve as proxy, but the LOINC observation itself must not be labeled 'Smallpox' in the data model -- the specific Variola interpretation belongs in a separate result/organism field (LOINC's own answer list for this code includes 'Presumptive positive identification of Variola virus', supporting this as the correct surveillance-level term).

Tuberculosis Sputum Culture.notes: Mycobacterium sp identified in Sputum by Organism specific culture -- genus-level, not M. tuberculosis-specific. Dr. Sameh: approve as the culture OBSERVATION; MTB complex/species identification belongs in the result field, not the LOINC code.

Tuberculosis GeneXpert MTB/RIF.notes: This assay is genuinely TWO observations, not one: MTB detection (38379-4, Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex DNA Presence by NAA) AND rifampin-resistance-gene detection (33634-7, separate LOINC code). Dr. Sameh: do not collapse these into a single observation. Primary test_code stores the MTB-detection result (38379-4); the rifampin-resistance result (33634-7) is NOT YET representable by the current single-test_code schema -- flagged as the clearest concrete case (along with Lyme Tier 2 and Widal H-antigen) for a future schema change adding a second result field per lab record.

Zika Virus PCR.notes: Generic specimen; Serum-specific variant (85622-9) available if needed. Approved.
